steps.title: Sam Okoro: fleet customer handover · part 1
steps.detail: Sam is documenting a used van for a new fleet customer. A service record shows brake work is due. Which handover note protects the customer?

choices.label: Disclose the brake work and ask for a repair quote

steps.title: Sam Okoro: fleet customer handover · part 2
steps.detail: Sam notices a fleet brochure promises unlimited uptime, but the rental contract allows maintenance days. What should his corrected guide say?

choices.label: State maintenance days and the replacement process

steps.title: Sam Okoro: fleet customer handover · part 3
steps.detail: Sam introduces a large fleet buyer for a paid handover project. The buyer wants every vehicle certified without inspections. What do you agree to deliver?

choices.label: A checked handover pack with inspection exceptions

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented fleet customer handover. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Sam Okoro.
